test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In March 2022, National Informatics Centre (NIC) organised Tech Conclave 2022 specially focused on emerging technologies applied in e-Governance. What is the theme of that event?

options.text: Next-Gen Skill Technologies for Digitisation of Government

solution:
The correct answer is __**Next-Gen Technologies for Digital Government**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The theme of **Tech Conclave 2022**, organised by the **National Informatics Centre (NIC) in March 2022**, was **Next-Gen Technologies for Digital Government**.
 
• The conclave focused on the application of emerging technologies in e-Governance.
 
• The event aimed to showcase the advancements and potential of next-generation technologies to enhance digital governance.
 
• Topics discussed included **artificial intelligence, machine learning, blockchain**, and other cutting-edge technologies relevant to the digital transformation of government services.
 
• The conclave served as a platform for experts, policymakers, and stakeholders to share insights and experiences on leveraging technology for efficient governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Informatics Centre (NIC) is a premier technology advisor and ICT solution provider to the Government of India.
 
• NIC plays a crucial role in implementing and managing e-Governance initiatives across various government departments and agencies.
 
• Tech Conclave 2022 provided a platform to demonstrate NIC's ongoing efforts and future plans to integrate emerging technologies into government operations.
 
• The conclave also aimed to foster collaboration between the government and technology industry leaders to drive digital transformation.
